impact.text: This Bug allows An attacker to DOS the order book by placing `reduce-only` order with tiny size and an arbitrarily large price to massively inflate `metadata.quoteOI` causing other users’ BUY Order to revert.

precondition_sources.text: A reduce-only order is placed with a tiny amount and an arbitrarily large price.
For a reduce-only order no collateral is involved in setting up the order.

intent_sources.text: Open interest must not be inflatable with extreme values; notional and price caps relative to mark price should prevent attackers from inflating open interest.
